description: Altria Group, Inc. has a leading portfolio of tobacco products for U.S. tobacco consumers age 21 and older, and is Moving Beyond Smoking by responsibly transitioning adult smokers to a smoke-free future, competing vigorously for existing smoke-free adult nicotine consumers and exploring new growth opportunities beyond the United States and beyond nicotine. Its wholly owned subsidiaries include Philip Morris USA, engaged in the manufacture and sale of cigarettes; John Middleton, engaged in machine-made large cigars; UST and U.S. Smokeless Tobacco Company, engaged in moist smokeless tobacco products; Helix Innovations, which sells oral nicotine pouches; and NJOY, which sells e-vapor products to customers in the United States. Substantially all of its oral tobacco products are manufactured and sold in the United States.
